parameters.generator: independent standard normal float64 features for every cell
parameters.multiplicity: Holm over all nine planned programs
parameters.outcome: any Holm-adjusted conditional_heterogeneity rejection in one simulation
parameters.confidence_interval: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95% interval for simulation familywise rejection frequency
parameters.anti_conservatism_diagnostic: one-sided exact binomial test against nominal familywise rate 0.05; no tuning or reruns

scope: Synthetic calibration of conditional cell-level identity testing with stipulated matches. Not biological evidence, marker-enrichment calibration, SAE-learning validation, or discovery.
paired_generic_check_scope: Paired rank-invariance checks share datasets with the null simulations and are not additional independent trials.
